title: Letter from Oliver Cowdery, 6 November 1829
source_note: Oliver Cowdery, Letter, Manchester Township, Ontario Co., NY, to JS, [Harmony Township, Susquehanna Co., PA], 6 Nov. 1829. Featured version copied [between ca. 27 Nov. 1832 and ca. Jan. 1833] in JS Letterbook 1, pp. 6–8; handwriting of JS; JS Collection, CHL. For more complete source information, see the source note for JS Letterbook 1.
